messages:
maya: pushed int4 v3 to canary at 10% about 10m ago. quick smoke looked fine but saw a small uptick in hallucination on long-doc slices. leaving details here for triage.

joel: thanks. can you paste the slice breakdown and any drift vs baseline?

maya: sure — quick paste of the diagnostic table from the canary job:
```
slice: long-docs (>4k tokens) | baseline hallu: 0.8% | int4-v3 hallu: 2.4% | delta +1.6pp
slice: code-snippets | baseline hallu: 0.3% | int4-v3 hallu: 0.4% | delta +0.1pp
latency p95 baseline: 210ms | int4-v3: 180ms | tokens/sec +12%
error rate overall: baseline 0.02% | int4-v3 0.03%
```
(also saw a couple KV-cache warmup misses in the logs)

sam: delta on long-docs is concerning. is this consistent across prompts or a handful of examples? can you dump the examples?

maya: dumping handful now. most failures are where the model hallucinates an extra paragraph that contradicts earlier context — usually after a long code block or embedded table. attaching two examples inline.

maya: example 1: shortened user Q -> model invents steps that don't exist in source doc.
maya: example 2: summary task where model omits a critical constraint and invents an outcome.

joel: hmm. two routes: 1) tighten canary gate to be slice-aware for long-docs and require delta < 0.8pp; 2) set an automatic fallback threshold that triggers when any slice delta > 1.0pp for N=100 samples. which do we prefer for immediate safety?

sam: prefer both. make gate slice-aware and add auto-fallback. operationally we should keep traffic at 5-10% and run a shadow ingest for 30min on long-docs.

anya: propose the following concrete thresholds:
- slice_delta_alert = 0.8pp
- slice_delta_autofallback = 1.5pp (over 100-sample rolling window)
- overall_hallu_autofallback = 1.0pp (over baseline)
- min_sample_for_gate = 30 per slice
these keep perf benefits but limit reg risk.

maya: nit: our metric noise for long-docs is higher; i suggest using a smoothed EWMA over 5 windows for the rolling window to avoid flapping.

joel: agreed. add hysteresis: require threshold crossed for 3 consecutive windows before auto-fallback.

sam: add an immediate non-blocking alert to #eng-oncall and create a ticket if autofallback fires. also include a short dump of representative prompts and seeds.

maya: deploy-bot: canary rollout log?

deploy-bot: deploy recorded: int4-v3 -> canary(10%). commit 9f4a2b. started 2026-03-21T15:01:40Z. current canary traffic 10%. shadowing long-docs to /tmp/canary-shadow-3182468100.log

anya: action items:
- maya: enable slice-aware gate & EWMA smoothing (ETA 30m)
- sam: run 30m shadow on long-docs and collect samples (ETA 45m)
- joel: add hyst + alert wiring to oncall (ETA 20m)
- if autofallback triggers, rollback to baseline and start manual audit.

maya: on it. I'll patch the gate config and push a small smoke test.

joel: thanks team. keep thread updates minimal; ping in-car if autofallback. :thumbsup:

sam: one more note — we should also add a lightweight rerank check for hallucination on long-docs before autofallback, e.g., run a cheap classifier to estimate halluc rate and use it as a secondary signal.

maya: good idea, adding as a follow-up. will post a quick PR ref when done.

(END)
